text: we will implement shift control for sub grid snapping and alt for freeform, and then multi-peice select + full object select.
resolution: Implemented the loader-iso pane snapping modifiers + selection ergonomics. (1) SHIFT sub-grid: added SnapInput.subgrid + a subgridDivisions P2 tuning row (default 2 = half-cell 0.5m); resolveSnapTarget snaps grid and edge placements to the finer lattice when held, opting out of module/plate/wall anchoring — the snapped sibling of Alt freeform, while default placement stays module-pitch flush (GRIDSNAP-0605). (2) ALT freeform was already wired/ruled (req_0596 'flush against the wall') — left untouched, verified intact by the existing REQ-0596/REQ-0650 suites. (3) Multi-piece select: Ctrl-click now toggles a piece in/out of the running selection (togglePieceAt) instead of replacing. (4) Whole-object select: double-click (350ms) selects the connected object via connected(). Untangled the modifier overload — while armed shift/alt only place (removed shift-click-while-armed select); selection gestures moved off shift/alt. Snap math locked by two new suites (35/35 green); full cart bundles clean. Live by-feel verification (holding the keys in rjit dev) is the user's acceptance step.
